notes.title: Hotel Tales hit 30k Wishlists!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/1ab06bab765320233f06278a4d36b12ce8af6fc9.png[/img]

[h3]The streak of surprises continues: we’re thrilled to announce that Hotel Tales has surpassed 30,000 wishlists! A huge thanks to all of you for your support and attention to the project![/h3]

We’re already hard at work on the bonus packs and community items unlocked through wishlist milestones. We’ve got plenty of exciting ideas for these rewards, and we’re sure you share our enthusiasm.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/d0eb1e024746cb43b54f1fba5f74f0563160eaba.png[/img]

This game is a very special project for us. It has gone through many stages: countless mechanics were designed, reworked, and ultimately left behind as we searched for the perfect fit. Guests came and went, checking out with promises to return, while new ones took their place. Now we’re close to release, and the final result is the fruit of tremendous effort put into realizing our vision of Hotel Tales.

We’re more confident than ever and racing toward launch. Very soon we’ll share the exact release date, and believe us — we’re just as eager as you are. So start booking your rooms and clearing your weekends now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

But on your first night, something happens that changes everything: it turns out you have a rare gift — an Amplifier, the ability to amplify other people's magic. Meet the eccentric residents of dormitory number 9 ¾ and get to know them as well as you can…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/498149e3a3d4d09df7bc9f54e31b0c0ef8e9875a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/2ac77fa2f44a16323339d530512da6cfb9e0b08b.png"][/img][/p][h3]What awaits you?[/h3][p]💙 Follow the daily assignments (can something terrible happen if you don't do them?...)[/p][p]💙 A rich calendar of events - each day brings new challenges, unexpected encounters and plot twists.[/p][p]💙 Mini games and activities - study, take magic tests, participate in activities.[/p][p]💙 Explore the campus - secret rooms, unusual teachers and strange neighbors are waiting for you.[/p][p]💙 A unique talent – help (or hinder) others using your unique ability. Each decision changes your relationship with the characters and the future plot.[/p][p]💙 And of course, build romantic relationships. Flirt, make friends, fall in love, or make enemies. Your words and actions shape the story, from innocent friendly scenes to passionate and risky moments.[/p][p]Without your support, nothing of this would have been possible! So hurry up and start the game to dive into the world of FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE. You can find the DLC here 👇[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58257/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE__Deluxe_Edition"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Pre-release devlog! 👑
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/f6c18f78f502d962ffe904ed96c100057040a3c2.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]👑 Princes, we’ve been silent for a while... because the kingdom has been bustling with work![/b][/h3][p]Over the past three months, Becoming a King has grown and matured: new walls have risen, battlefields have been prepared, weapons polished, and the prince’s throne is nearly ready…[/p][p]We've been working so hard to welcome our heir that we sometimes forget to report back to our noble monarchs![/p][p]In this devlog, we’ll tell you everything that has happened since the last update — and what awaits you very, very soon.[/p][p]Be sure to read all the way to the end - something exciting awaits you there… 👀[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/24becd320aefdc5b92540e716d5357780dfe3590.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]📖 [b]The story grows deeper, with more scenes and sharper turns![/b][/h3][p]Every prince will now have the chance to learn much more about the kingdom and the lady of his heart. Moreover, the story of the prince itself will grow progressively! You will uncover the truth of your parent’s death soon enough…[/p][list][*][p]Story expanded to 25+ weeks [/p][/*][*][p]Fully reworked dialogue journal interface[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/4683b1ba4421dbf4c6d3d4314e1750df24a67e75.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]🛍️ New locations and activities for our noble monarchs![/b][/h3][p]To keep your reign exciting, we’ve opened the gates to new places and invented new activities. A full-fledged combat system is now live, the city now features real shops, courtrooms, an arena…[/p][p]You won’t get bored once you step outside the castle walls!
[/p][h3]🔔 [b]City improvements:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Shops now available at the town square and brothel[/p][/*][*][p]New levels added for Patrol, Court, and Performance activities[/p][/*][*][p]New backgrounds: forest, theater, court, shops[/p][/*][*][p]Interface improvements across several screens and systems[/p][/*][*][p]Unique music tracks for meta-activities (Hunt, Court, Performance)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated music for main locations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🗡️ [b]Story battles:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fight with the assassin (main story)[/p][/*][*][p]Fight with the bouncers (part of one girl's storyline)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/22c42b73be021794ea37a370d5b911cad108eaa9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]❤️‍🔥 [b]You may have noticed... Becoming a King has pushed some boundaries.[/b][/h3][p]As of this month, the game is officially 18+ only! All intimate scenes will now be included in the main game! No more extra downloads or patches needed to truly get to know your future queen…[/p][p]But worry not, dear romantics! We're also continuing work on 16+ dating content — and we promise, no lady will deny a proper prince a lovely date.[/p][list][*][p]New H-scenes have been added for several girls…  [/p][/*][*][p]…but we won’t spoil the surprise just yet 🤭[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/5056ca637f047ee7acd700c925b69e0d8426f596.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]🛠️ And beyond all that, your rule just got even more comfortable![/b][/p][p]We’ve added a series of quality-of-life improvements to enhance your experience:[/p][list][*][p][i]Week counter added[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i] Notifications for stat, relationship, and gold changes [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i] Save system reworked: auto-save now triggers at the start of each week[/i][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 We know you've waited patiently — and we thank you for it. With each new build, we draw closer to the biggest moment yet:[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Full release of Becoming a King, coming in late August![/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us, supporting us, sharing feedback, and helping to shape this kingdom. We’ll see you very soon, heirs to the throne![/p][p]With love,
Your Becoming a King team 💕[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/5412716d13c4d4b6f7cd68c1d434095354bb3500.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: It’s time to meet the Queen of Moonriver! 😍
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/99fb0572aeb8bc45abfdea475cbae668bfec4abe.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome beyond the palace walls, princes! 🏰[/p][p]The heralds have brought news for everyone. In the dialogues between characters, you may have already seen mention of the province of Moonriver - the land of rebels who have declared independence. Now it's time to learn about their queen 👑[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597020/Becoming_a_King/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]🤔 [b]Who is Zenara?[/b][/p][p]She is a mighty warrior and a strong leaderwho has been recognized by the people as their leader. She is bold in pursuing her desires: if she wants ale, she will drink it; if she wants to win, she will do so with such force that her enemies will flee to the ends of the earth, barely able to pick up their pants.[/p][p]Moonriver, now a haven for fugitives and outcasts, stands between hostile powers, becoming an unstable but influential power. Zenara, their beloved queen, must determine the future of the province, while the future ruler of Solmont must decide what kind of relationship you will have with her, as your fates are intertwined 🔥[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/6ccc94d8cb1bb468b1d847443e953bfd351aa4eb.png"][/img][/p][p]💪🏻 New look[/p][p]Zenara is an experienced woman in many ways. She lost her husband, went through bloody battles, and defended her people with her chest and axe. The mighty ruler of Moonriver combines the blood of humans and the mysterious inhabitants of the Kingdom of the Full Moon. Her image changed a lot during development, but the key features remained: a battle axe, a fur cape, and her distinctive rebellious style. What's more, she can look down on all the girls we know, and even Bernard and Harrent - Zenara is taller than most of the characters 😉[/p][p]Now her appearance fully reflects her as a leader — charismatic and headstrong, as a woman — luxurious and determined ♨️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/869d0885fc9b3aaf49be468cb470c7cf4b2f91c0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]👀 Mini version[/p][p]In order to speak with Zenara, you need to approach her first. Therefore, she will appear on the map in this form. It is evident that her chibi will demonstrate the full power of the rebellious queen 😱[/p][p]How do you like Zenara? Aren't you afraid of sharing a bed with her?[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597020/Becoming_a_King/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Battle interface work progress
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/3b5c35c5fa4583277cd419f3d791d6d271d1e5ea.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Honorable Princes, we welcome you to the developmental halls! 👑[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597020/Becoming_a_King

Today we are going to reveal to you a veil of mystery and tell you how the kingdom is built from the point of view of UX/UI-design. We worked like blacksmiths to make sure that the battle interface would not only be functional, but also give you a true pleasure of the game! 🎮🔥

[i]Prepare a mug of ale and turn on the wave of aesthetic pleasure! 🍺✨[/i]

[h3][b]🗺️ Where do we go this time?[/b][/h3]

Here is how the path choice screen will look like - familiar lands await, and uncharted ones lurk beneath a veil of mystery. Each road promises dangers, discoveries and of course, rewards! Where will you go first? 🏰⛰️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/a983fa606310b514d23f61cd8ce5d20f1a318c18.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]📚 Upgrade your hero's skills[/b][/h3]

Increase your basic attack, upgrade your armor, or choose a healing spark with a chance to restore HP with an attack - it all depends on your choice! The upgrade system offers unlimited possibilities for character development: follow your instincts (or strategy) 👑🧠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/476d51b5f2d49602a7d2b31129e9f6793559a563.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]⚔️ Battle Screen[/b][/h3]

You will face epic battles with a multitude of enemies, including ominous wolf-monsters! 🐺💥 Now take a look at this screen - how thoughtful and exciting everything is! Every detail, from the barely visible grass on the edge of the forest to the bright rays of sunlight streaming through the woods, puts you in the atmosphere of an intense battle 🎨🔥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/4a3e4fec7335e3cba12d62e0b8a5252a2789b7c5.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]⚔️ Victory and Defeat[/b][/h3]

Each battle is a step towards your glory! If you win, this screen will shine as triumph, while defeat will sharpen your determination and reinforce your desire to fight again! ⚔️💥 No matter how the battle turns out, these screens remind you of how you have fought to the end without giving up! 👑🔥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/0b703f44dc714e1c8d1b5a3f665c3ae4c33a93fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/59236f8af333a2d9aa2c4f37b24aca7395e5db06.jpg[/img]

[i]Princes, what do you think? Does this interface make your eyes happy? Is everything convenient, or is there something to work on? Don't be shy - every feedback is really important for us! 💬👇[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/086cf2a188e943ceab37ed37e53f75fbcf32b8b4.png[/img]

notes.title: April Devlog: What’s new in the kingdom 👑✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/f209d43772ce2612f9364bf09ec275f1a8ea63e1.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🔔Attention, attention, attention, the messenger is on his way with a fresh devlog! 🔔[/b][/h3]
You've been waiting, you've been guarding the gates... And here it is, hot off the presses, straight from the royal kitchen - this month’s devlog! The development team is like a tavern in the middle of a feast - noisy, fun and busy as can be. So let's not procrastinate, let's tell you what we’ve got cooking for you this time! 🍻🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597020/Becoming_a_King

[h3][b]🏗️ Building the foundation: basic mechanics[/b][/h3]
The royal forge keeps on going strong! Very soon the game will have a calendar that will help you not to miss any important events in your reign 🔔📅

And to make sure you don't miss any details, notifications will remind you of the consequences of your decisions and actions 👑✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/34fea4d7f9a72e0398eefc5397b65330923eff90.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]🎭Life beyond the throne: new activities[/h3][/b]
To make life in the kingdom not seem monotonous, we are adding various activities that will not only level up your characteristics, but also give you a lot of fun! 🎉👑

In addition to the combat you will be waiting for:

👨‍⚖️[b] Court[/b] - level upyour mind and figure out who stole the pies again 
🎭 [b]Theater[/b] - square your shoulders, shine and level up your charisma!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/fd1cda7b54f70697999fb207ce4f6e2495c7fe96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/f42610b48c30a5814d3a52016ccfa4b4eceb74e5.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]🎨The magic of the kingdom comes to life: art and animations[/h3][/b]
Our artists work wonders! ✨ Today we're happy to introduce you to chibi townspeople who will be happily strolling through your kingdom. Look closely - these adorable creatures will soon become your loyal subjects! 👑💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/60dbe40d176760831177cb17dea12c921dd9975a.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]👾And behind the scenes....[/h3][/b]
Things are bubbling and buzzing like the heart of the kingdom 🔥👑:

[i]🖋️ The script is being written so you can't tear your eyes away from each and every line
🎮 Builds that will open up new horizons are being planned
🎵 Music that will fill your adventures with magic is being made[/i]

Each and every one of us works tirelessly to make your journey truly unforgettable - from the first click to the last line 🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569256/54053804073911c20b7dbbbe068545819e364c86.jpg[/img]
Thank you for staying with us, supporting us and writing us kind words - they act as the most powerful buff! 💖✨

Until further news, princes. In the meantime - hold the crown tight and don't let the pies get cold! 🥧😋
